headline.text: L3 Truffle Line bottomer mesh found *broken* during Level 2 clean final inspection — requires repair before next run.

summary: Three sanitation gaps surfaced today: broken mesh at L3 Truffle, moisture intrusion at L1 Sollich 1 tunnel head, and a replaced conveyor belt at L3 ML1 sent to production without cleaning verification. One quality issue — 6 pallets at L1 S2 need re-labeling.

food_safety.title: Bottomer mesh broken during cleaning inspection
food_safety.summary: Truffle Line bottomer mesh found broken during final inspection after Level 2 clean — flagged for repair before next production run to prevent potential metal fragments or contamination.
food_safety.status: Open, awaiting maintenance repair before next startup.

quality.title: 6 pallets require re-labeling after labeler malfunction
quality.summary: S2 A-side labeler failure forced shift to slower B-side unit — 6 pallets produced during transition need re-labeling before release.
quality.status: On hold pending re-labeling; tech support scheduled for Monday.

sanitation.title: Moisture detected at Sollich 1 Tunnel 1 head
sanitation.summary: Cleaning inspection found moisture traces on refrigeration filter and damp dust under conveyor belt at tunnel head — source under investigation before area release.
sanitation.status: Open, under investigation to determine moisture source before tunnel released.

sanitation.title: ML1 C1 conveyor belt replaced without cleaning verification
sanitation.summary: Maintenance replaced C1 belt but did not clean or ATP test before releasing to production — QA flagged and required cleaning plus ATP completion before startup.
sanitation.status: Resolved — cleaning and ATP completed before line started.

opportunities.text: Consider adding mandatory cleaning verification sign-off to maintenance work-order closeout checklist — based on ML1 C1 belt replacement that reached production floor without cleaning or ATP.
